purpose: Compact crosswalk of the two non-sentinel selector initializer arguments to a local Dishonored Recompiled 2013 retail symbol/native export snapshot.

external_snapshot.commit_note: The available directory is a source snapshot without a .git directory or recorded commit identifier.

joins: Selector initializer target VA is joined exactly to natives_2013.csv va and functions_2013.csv va.
Token is compared as an integer to natives_2013.csv native_index.
functions_2013.csv mangled name is joined to match_2012_2013.csv name, and RVA to rva_2013.
The retail build identity is independently checked against the registered build record and local install manifest by the EXP-0163 audit.
export_method_review: The inspected export_natives.py documents numbered registration as push <iNative>, push <function-pointer-variable>, call GRegisterNative; it recovers the function pointer and signed index from the call site, and also scans GNatives plus inlined Core stores. The selected 0x180/0x181 values are positive numbered indices.
limitations: These are compacted rows from a local third-party snapshot; repository commit identity is unavailable.

The exports do not themselves embed the retail executable SHA-256; exact-build applicability is supported by the snapshot documentation and matching project build registry, not by an embedded per-row hash.

functions_2013.csv names are propagated from a 2012 PDB. Both selected rows have byte-match ratio 1.000 and equal 2012/2013 function sizes in match_2012_2013.csv, which supports identity correspondence but does not make the 2012 PDB an authority for retail layouts.
The GNatives index/native registration row identifies a registered exec binding, but does not establish runtime execution, gameplay reachability, or behavioral semantics.
Absence from the project EXP-0066-derived 207-row NativeToken catalog is scoped to that catalog only.
